To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
machine learning models can be used to predict energy usage in buildings, and that the performance of these models can be improved by using a combination of weather data and building data.
machine learning based models can be applied for forecasting short and medium term future energy requirement of the water source pump.
the machine learning models can forecast short and medium term power usage of water source heat pump with a reasonable accuracy and can also predict the impact of climate on power usage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a machine learning based model for short term energy forecasting of water source heat pump and its validation.
the short and medium term forecasting of energy demand using machine learning based approaches.
the development of a short and medium term forecasting models that can predict the energy demand for water source heat pumps with high precision.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed machine learning based models are efficient and reliable for short and medium-term energy forecasting of water source heat pump.
the proposed models are more accurate and efficient in forecasting short and medium term electricity usage in buildings.
the CDT model is the most accurate model with the lowest MAE, RMPE and RMSE for both weekly and monthly forecasting.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed machine learning based models have a better forecasting performance than the existing models for short and medium terms.
the CDT model has the highest forecasting efficiency and accuracy among the proposed models and the other validation models.
the proposed machine learning based models can be applied to forecast the energy usage in a building background with inadequate climatic and power usage data.

the proposed models have a better performance for short-term forecasting of the future energy requirement in water source heat pumps, and can be used to forecast the future energy demand of the building.
the machine learning models can forecast the energy requirement of the water source pumps in a short and medium term with a reasonable accuracy.
